result:
Everything is in place and untouched from committing, per the instruction not to commit. Summary of the change:

- Removed the committed `Documentation/examples/observations.txt` fixture and added it to `.gitignore`.
- Added `crates/ucal/tests/common/mod.rs`, a shared helper (`TempObservations`) that writes the four synthetic observations to a uniquely-named temp file per call (pid + atomic counter), fixing the actual race the committed fixture had worked around rather than reintroducing it.
- `json_surface.rs` and `manual_fields.rs` now call `common::TempObservations::write()` instead of reading the committed file.
- `xtask/src/examples.rs`'s `generate()` (used by both `gen-examples` and `check-docs`) now writes the same synthetic fixture to `Documentation/examples/observations.txt` before invoking the real binary, so the worked-example generation stays self-contained too.

Verified: `cargo test -q -p ucal --no-fail-fast` (default and `--features full`) and `cargo test -q -p xtask --no-fail-fast` all pass, and `cargo run -p xtask -- check-docs` still validates the worked examples end-to-end. No commit was made.
